title: What It Means to Be a Master

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Grandpa.
Um... sorry for dropping in out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Don't sweat it. ...So, the one over there... you're—

I apologize for the sudden visit and explain the situation. Believe's grandfather
gives a slow, silent nod, then gestures toward a small truck parked by the road.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: ...Get in. If you wanna see my work, watch as much as you like.

We follow him to his worksite, and watching him work—
just as Believe described, "magnificent" is the only word for it.

To be honest, before this, my understanding of plastering was
limited to roughly "someone who spreads coating over walls"—

But watching his swift, unwavering trowel work and the way the wall takes on a pristine finish
without a single guideline, the sheer depth of his mastery is unmistakable.

A race against time. Swift, yet precise, before the plaster dries.
His focus is so absolute it makes even onlookers forget to breathe—
choice_data_list: How can you produce work of this caliber...?!

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
...Bet on the moment.
Pour everything you have into it. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Believe's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, you can't be fast.
...Being fast is what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Grandpa really is... amazing...!

In that moment, watching Believe gaze at her grandfather's work
with eyes sparkling more purely than I've ever seen—
A clear idea crystallizes in my mind.

Later, invited into her grandparents' home,
I sit down to talk things over with Believe. The idea I had is—
choice_data_list: Let's stake everything on the 1,200m, Believe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...The 1,200m?
Just... sprint races?

Her surprise is only natural. It's a path none of the veteran trainers before me
would ever have suggested. And practically speaking, their approach was the orthodox one.

Narrowing your battlefield reduces the glory within reach. It limits your options.
Restricting yourself solely to 1,200m does so even more. But—
choice_data_list: Let's not look elsewhere. Let's focus purely on your true dream.
Let's not look elsewhere. Let's focus purely on your true dream.

text_block_list.text:
The "speed" Believe is striving for... that kind of "speed" her grandfather embodies.
It's a realm you can only reach by dedicating yourself entirely.

Hone a single craft, walk a single path, polish and master it to perfection—
and see it through. All for the sake of that single instant of pure speed.
choice_data_list: A six-furlong blitz—that's going to be our workplace!
A six-furlong blitz—that's going to be our workplace!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...Our workplace.)

—The next day. After seeing off her grandparents,
Believe and I return from America to Tracen Academy, and...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
So... um. Starting today—
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's dive straight into sprint training!
Yep. Let's dive straight into sprint training!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Let's get to work.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Hah...!
choice_data_list: Great start! Keep picking up the pace!
Great start! Keep picking up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Right! ...Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I can focus.
...I can sustain it. At this distance... only at this distance!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Believe. Run alongside us.
Right now. Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Hold it! ...Pardon the sudden intrusion, Miss Believe.
However, I too would like to request a mock race. Would you do us the honor?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well... sure.
But why so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Unlike before, you're doing sprint-specialized training.
Alongside someone who seems to be your new Trainer. That is why.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Light O and I also make sprints our primary battlefield.
Which means—we will be rivals from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A chance to gauge where we all stand...
Surely that is not an unfavorable proposition, is it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Understood.
I'll get permission from my Trainer. —Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
TOOOOOOOH!!
Fastest! Absolute fastest! MAXIMUM SPEED!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Light O-san's speed is unmatched.
And Durandal-san's late-stretch kick is ferocious.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (But I—the way I am now—!!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Not yet. I can still hold on—!!
—Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see, it is impossible!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ngh?! Her pace isn't dropping—?!
Miss Believe... to think you had such power...!

After successfully finishing ahead of both Calstone Light O and Durandal,
Believe walks over to where I'm standing.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I ran fast.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Faster than ever before. I... produced good work.
So—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I want to entrust myself to you.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Will you... take on the job of working with me?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Grandpa? ...Thanks for the other day.
Yeah. ...Yeah, I'm—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to give it everything with this Trainer.
...I'll work hard. ...Yeah.
